name: original_neural_terminal_pilot_v1
hypothesis: Original v5 DiT-RF can learn local terminal actions after same-observation executable moving recovery supervision on both OCT sides.
observations: Two true RGB frames + same-call signed measured OCT + actual encoder ABC; original float32 state finite-difference velocity and previous accepted action, as production get_action
setup: Existing pilot.make_start: target-C +/-90um then24 approach3um +2 reverse3um G10 ticks; truth only for setup/scoring, never model input
data_reuse: Original prefix/teacher interfaces reused; missing RGB requires four fresh40-tick matched teacher continuations; no ridge X/Y used as visual data
windows: horizon16 action labels, RGB2 and history continuous within each40-tick segment; final prefix frames supply prior observation, no segment concatenation
teacher: homog_replay_common.make_teacher.geometry_action_from_observation, actual previous velocity and same-call strict RGBD; labels are production accepted actions

training.learning_rate_source: v5 A attention_lr current effective prescription; constant
training.amp_scaler: Original dynamic GradScaler defaults; skipped overflow attempts do not update parameters or count toward128 updates; at most144 attempts
training.freeze: vision.* requires_grad False, eval, buffers bit-exact; all other original parameters trainable

offline_gate.primary: E41 moving_encoder_C MAE_um strictly decreases AND direction accuracy on nonzero C moving_encoder rows strictly increases
offline_gate.ab: E41 all-window AND moving-encoder A and B MAE each <= before, numeric zero tolerance
offline_gate.output_scale: physical first action clipped only by unchanged production caps; raw metrics also reported
offline_gate.moving: abs(actual encoder C velocity mm/s)>1e-6, sign accuracy further requires abs(accepted teacher C mm)>1e-9
offline_gate.groups: all, moving_encoder, nonzero_C, approaching, receding, crossing, hold; absent groups explicit count0/null

closed_loop.all_actions: Only unchanged original neural model.sample through PolicyEvaluator.get_action; prefix history seeded from actual RGB/encoder/accepted commands; no teacher instantiated
metrics: all240 post-action true distances including final

checks: normal production sample agrees with standalone input/sample
production limits andG10 actual first command

runtime: him1 host, deployment .venv, GPU0 RTX4090, NVIDIA EGL
